packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-06 -- first reader response (unverified image reading, UTF-8 plain text)

Exposure statement: nothing in my context revealed a proposed identification or reading of this packet. Only the reader brief, PROMPT.md and the packet images (plus my own crops, if any) were opened. The directory listing of the packet folder was run once to learn the image filenames and pixel sizes.

LAYOUT SURVEY (from overview image-001)
- image-001: two separate paper leaves photographed side by side on black, with colour checker and cm scale. Pencil shelfmark-style notes at foot: left leaf "Stams, STA, Frg. 232-2r", right leaf "Stams, STA, Frg. 232-1r" (modern pencil, observed only).
- Script: German-language cursive (Kurrent-type) chancery/draft hand, brown ink, fast; many strike-throughs and interlinear insertions. Looks like a draft (Konzept) of a letter or document. Observation, not identification.
- Right leaf (232-1r): single column, ~29 lines, wide left margin. At top-left margin a short heading/address "Durch[?] Cantz[?]" and a large flourished majuscule/signature-like device with long descenders in the left margin. Text begins with a large initial in line 1. Some deletions with interlinear additions (e.g. line 1-2).
- Left leaf (232-2r): main text column on the right half (~33 lines) with heavy deletions (underlined/struck words) and interlinear additions; the left half carries marginal additions keyed with signs: a "+" / cross sign block at top (~7 lines), a "+" block lower (~3 lines), and a block at foot keyed with a sign (~5 lines). These are insertions belonging to the main column (tentative).
- No rubrics, no columns of formal book layout, no running titles.
- Tiles: image-002..017 are a 4x4 grid of native-resolution tiles over this overview (row-major, overlapping). Cols 1-2 = left leaf (margin, main column); cols 3-4 = right leaf.
- image-018 is a second overview (another face); tiles 019-030 (4 cols x 3 rows) cover it. Survey of that face follows below when viewed.

TRANSCRIPTION CONVENTIONS: line numbers count from the top of the tile image. (?) = uncertain. [illegible] = could not read. [del: ...] = struck text. [ins: ...] = interlinear addition. Expansions in parentheses.

=== FACE A (overview image-001) ===

--- image-002 (top-left tile: left leaf, upper margin block + left edge of main column) ---
Left-margin addition block, keyed by a "#"-like sign (two crossed strokes) above line 1. Hand is fast; letter forms very uncertain.
image-002 l.1  [sign "#"]
image-002 l.2  Dhyllich(?) Volgeb(?) . vnd ein(?)
image-002 l.3  Hs(?) . an dannen(?) Uni(?) . vz(?) das(?) nit
image-002 l.4  zu standen(?) gegeben(?) . kunglich(?) [long tail sweeps right toward main column]
image-002 l.5  vnd fein(?) [ein/zu?]sse(?)ren(?) hinglich(?) . vnd
image-002 l.6  zu Vrnitt(?) [?]gehalt(en)(?) . [?]sto(?) be:
image-002 l.7  geza(?) . Euch(?) . vo(?) Vel . Jarz(?) maist
(block continues on image-006)
Right edge: first letters of main-column lines (gebrau[..], kump[..], vnbe ge[..], mag(?) [..], derma[..], vab fin[..], Cal ver[..], veal ba[..]) -- read on image-003, not repeated here.

--- image-003 (top row, col 2: left leaf main column, lines 1-8) ---
image-003 l.1  gebraucht(?) zu abstellung(?) selber(?)        [large looped ascender above "abstellung"]
image-003 l.2  kumpe(?)[..]t theil(?) vnd thaüb(?)[..] gros(?)
image-003 l.3  vnbe(?) gefallen(?) . dagegen werden(?) by(?) gleich(?)
image-003 l.4  mag(?) [sign "#", keyed to a marginal addition] vnglich(?) vngepeit(?) zu sein(?) . [del: one word, struck/underlined]
                 [ins. above end of l.4-5: "versteelg(?)" / "verspell(?)" -- illegible insertion]
image-003 l.5  der maimung(?) . Vnd das(?) ob [del: Fürstlicher(?) / Landtfurst(?) -- struck word, underlined]
image-003 l.6  vab(?) fürd(?) erst(?) das haub(?) solch(er)(?) [..]
image-003 l.7  :Cal(?) verdienen(?) . Was d.y: gnade(?)  [mark ":" at line start ties to margin]
image-003 l.8  veal(?) bewußt(?) , am [ins. above: "bruchs(?) gemeiner(?) vor(?)"] [del: two words, underlined/struck, illegible]
(l.9 cut at bottom; continues on image-007)
Note: reading confidence on this tile is low throughout; letter forms of this fast Kurrent not settled.

--- image-004 (top row, col 3: right leaf, heading, left margin, beginning of text lines 1-8) ---
Top-left heading (above/left of text block), one line, followed by a dot:
image-004 l.1  Durchl(?): Cand[..](?) / Cantz(?)       [reads letter-for-letter "durchy: Cander." -- expansion uncertain]
Left margin: large flourished letters. A big looped majuscule (S or C?) with long descender, then a long horizontal heavy stroke crossing a tall stem, followed by "Abtt(?) C(?) cu:" or "Abtt(?) zu(?):" with an abbreviation mark (two dots/ superscript) after; a further very large looped stroke descends through the margin (visible down to bottom of tile). Interpretation as a name/title or as calligraphic pen trials is uncertain; letters "Abtt" fairly clear, the rest not.
Main text, line starts (line numbers from top of tile; text continues on image-005):
image-004 l.2  [large initial, B/G-like] nedig(?) herr(?) .        [= text line 1]
image-004 l.3  Cadinal(?) / Cardinal(?) Hoff(?) pu[..]
image-004 l.4  Vnd von(?) vnaulandt(?)[..]
image-004 l.5  selben(?) [e]rachte[..](?)
image-004 l.6  Dißlar(?) / Dißlang(?) : [del: one word struck through]
image-004 l.7  Vnd(?)t gnad(?)ist[..]
image-004 l.8  angetragen(?) . Vn[d]
image-004 l.9  Im fall(?) d.y(?): [..]

--- image-005 (top row, col 4: right leaf, line ends of text lines 1-9) ---
(overlaps image-004 by a few letters at left; full lines given combining both tiles where the join is clear)
image-005 l.1  [..nedig] herr(?) . Welch(er)massen(?) d.y(?):        [text line 1 end; "d.y:" = recurring 2-letter abbreviation with colon, unexpanded]
image-005 l.2  [Cadinal] Hoff(?) sein(?) Im [del: one word, struck and underlined] [ins. above it: "Ertzh[..]ng(?)" / "Erzhertzog(?)"] [..]ge(?) sob[..]ande(?)
image-005 l.3  [vnaulandt] agarlein(?) / ange(?)legen(?) Hoffhan(?) / Hoffhaim(?) , sein Vat[er](?)
image-005 l.4  [selben] [..]erabte(?) herren(?) vnd dero(?) Vatte[r](?)
image-005 l.5  [Dißlar :] [del: one word, struck through] Innamen(?) d(?) f(?): d(?)t(?):s(?)
image-005 l.6  [Vnd] gnadigisten(?) herren(?) th[..]ou(?) fleichen(?) / gleichen(?)
image-005 l.7  [ange]tragen(?) . Vnd fail[..](?) [..]sproch(?) . oder aber
image-005 l.8  [Im fa]ll d.y: [..] nit an zu(?) [..] bedacht .
image-005 l.9  [cut] [..]haimbait(?)  -- continues on image-009

--- image-006 (row 2, col 1: left leaf, end of top margin block; blank margin below) ---
Lines 1-2 repeat image-002 l.6-7 (overlap). Re-viewed here:
image-006 l.1  zu Vrnitt(?) [..]gehalt(en)(?) . [..]sto(?) be:     [= image-002 l.6; "be:" leads by a stroke to ":Cal" at start of main-column line, image-003 l.7 -- the addition seems to be inserted there (tentative)]
image-006 l.2  gezo(?) / Beza(?) . huf(?) / hoch(?) . vo(?) Vel(?) . Jarz(?) maist      [= image-002 l.7]
image-006 l.3  oder(?) [..]mer(?) zu(?) .        [last line of block; a large X-like sign below it, possibly an end/insertion mark]
Rest of tile: blank margin. Right edge: line-starts of main column (veal ba-, [del] obsc[..], dem(?) -, nottu[..], ob(?) und-, Damit(?)-, ershed(?)-, Doch-, [del]hit-, solch-, Vnd sol-) -- read on image-007.

--- image-007 (row 2, col 2: left leaf main column, lines ~7-19) ---
image-007 l.1  :Cal(?) verdienen(?) . Was d.y: gnade(n)(?)        [= image-003 l.7, overlap]
image-007 l.2  wol(?) bewußt(?) , am / an [ins. above: "truckhe(?) gemaind(?) dero(?)"] [del: "altes(?) erhebtes(?)" -- two words underlined/struck]   [= image-003 l.8]
image-007 l.3  [del: "abgesonder(?)[..]sat[..]en(?)" -- underlined/struck] . Dy Vrsach(?) selb(?)
image-007 l.4  dem(?) zu fürsten(?) / zufriden(?) [..]sch(?) . Was ob dis(?)
image-007 l.5  notturfft(?) erfordert . nit mag wol
image-007 l.6  ob [..]dauß(?) / kundauß(?) werden(?) [del: one short word, "kan(?)"] . Damit(?)
image-007 l.7  Dannoch(?) / Damit(?) des(?) herzogen(?) handels(?) . Vnnd
image-007 l.8  erhört(?) / erfordert(?) Vrsach(?) willen(?) . mit(?) gnaden(?) ,
image-007 l.9  Doch dar(?)gestellt(?) . [del: "vnd seit(?) [..]"] :      [three-word deletion, struck]
image-007 l.10 [del: "hait"] erlassen(?) . Nambli(ch)(?) dz Ime(?)
image-007 l.11 solchem(?) / so lang(?) [..] [ins. small above: "di(?)"] seiner Erbar[..]lich(?)
image-007 l.12 Vnd solt nur(?) [del: one word] zu bedenck(?)[..]      [last line cut]
Note: deletions in this column are made by underlining plus a horizontal stroke through the words.

--- image-008 (row 2, col 3: right leaf left margin and line-starts) ---
Margin: end of the large looped flourish from image-004 (a closed loop ending ~1/3 down the tile); otherwise blank. No marginal text.
Line-starts of right-leaf text (full lines read on image-009):

image-008 l.2  Im fall d.y: [..]             [= image-004 l.9]
image-008 l.3  Inn(?) selch(?) / solch(?) vnd[..]

--- image-009 (row 2, col 4: right leaf, line ends; text lines ~7-18) ---
Lines combined with starts from image-008 where the join is clear; bracketed starts come from image-008.
image-009 l.1  [angetragen .] Vnd fail[..](?) [..]sproch(?) . oder aber        [= image-005 l.7 overlap]
image-009 l.2  [Im fa]ll d.y: [..] nit an zu(?) [..] bedacht .               [= image-005 l.8]
image-009 l.3  [Inn s]elch(?) vndter(?) auch seiner gelegenheit(?)
image-009 l.4  [noch] hinrechen(?) / hinwegk(?)[..] stiften(?) gnedig(?) zuzeiget(?) / getzeiget(?)
image-009 l.5  [vnd Th]ains(?) erstatten(?) . Das haben(?) wir(?)

--- image-010 (row 3, col 1: left leaf margin, mostly blank; start of second marginal addition) ---

(block continues on image-014)
